claim: When encryption by default is disabled in the destination Region, a copy of an encrypted snapshot is automatically encrypted; you can specify the KMS key, and if you do not, the AWS managed key (aws/ebs) is used.
question: Which KMS key encrypts a copy of an encrypted snapshot when you do not name a key and encryption by default is off in the destination Region?

values.display: the AWS managed key (aws/ebs) is used

qualifiers.scope: copy of an encrypted EBS snapshot
qualifiers.condition: encryption by default disabled for the destination Region; no KMS key specified
